span.label: A PRIME THAT HURTS BECAUSE IT WAS IGNORED, WHICH IS A RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN PRIME AND TARGET THAT NOTHING ELSE IN THIS CORPUS HAS. `a reaction to a stimulus can be slowed down or more likely to be in error if the stimulus has recently been ignored.` The manipulation is an INSTRUCTION TO DISREGARD, so what carries over is the act of suppression. And it is a cost, not a benefit - the second counterexample tonight to the standard `improvement` definition Minton2017 strikes out, after Huang2018's interference effect
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND IGNORING IS NOT ENOUGH - IT HAD TO HAVE BEEN COMPETING: `Negative priming was observed only after conflict, but not after nonconflict, primes.` The ignored item must have called for a DIFFERENT response from the attended one. So the phenomenon is not about suppression in general but about suppression under competition, and a design that ignores an irrelevant stimulus with no competing response should find nothing. Another `only when`, and the condition is a property of the RELATION between the two primes rather than of either one
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE AUTHORS MARK EXACTLY HOW MUCH OF THEIR CONCLUSION RESTS ON SOMETHING THEY CANNOT TEST: `Although this unavoidable confound renders the interpretation of the present finding ambiguous in principle, we believe that the conflict/nonconflict nature of the primes, and not the prime-probe response alternation/repetition, determined the observed pattern.` Then: `Quotation withheld within...` Four markers in three sentences - unavoidable, ambiguous in principle, we believe, if this position is accepted - and everything downstream is explicitly conditional on the belief. The confound is structural: conflict primes necessarily change the response, so the two cannot be separated by any version of this design
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AN UNEXPECTED RESULT ADMITTED AS UNEXPLAINED: `The positive priming on nonconflict prime trials in the auditory-auditory condition was unexpected. Quotation withheld` The effect ran the WRONG WAY in one cell - facilitation where the paper predicts none - and it gets a paragraph of candidate explanations, each marked as speculation, rather than a footnote. A record that stored only the headline `negative priming after conflict primes` would lose a cell that contradicts the framework
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THREE ACCOUNTS ARE TESTED AGAINST THE SAME PATTERN AND ONE OF THEM HAS TO BE PATCHED: distractor inhibition and episodic retrieval both accommodate the conflict result, but for the temporal discrimination account `Quotation withheld.` Two alternative extensions are then offered, both hypothetical. The paper reports which theory needs extra machinery to survive its data, which is a more useful thing to record than which theory it prefers

span.label: conflict —causes→ negative priming
span.note: direction on the measure: increases · strength of the relation: 0.85 · note: THE 'only after' IS THE CLAIM AND IT IS IN THE QUOTE. Weight 0.85 rather than higher because of the confound the authors name themselves: conflict primes NECESSARILY change the response between prime and probe, so this edge and 'response alternation causes negative priming' are not separable by any version of this design. The paper says so - 'ambiguous in principle' - and the third sense carries it.
